svg.text: ORCHESTRATION LAB · CLAUDE · CODEX · OPENCODE · OLLAMA CLOUD
A few frontier orchestrators conduct a fabric of cheap parallel workers —
and everything they produce passes through deterministic gates before it counts.

g.text: The clock never forces a round.

svg.text: A
Where you sit — host surfaces
Four interchangeable front-ends over one deterministic core. The launcher pair c / g spins up named tmux sessions, local or on the GPU box over Tailscale.

g.text: Plans w/ Fable, builds w/ Opus.

svg.text: ▼ intent enters the frontier thread
B
Frontier orchestrators — plan · route · verify · sign off
The scarce, expensive brains: they own contracts, cross-file architecture, and final merge. Planning is delegated to a different model, then the root session builds it.

g.text: Orchestrates + verifies. Design step → a read-only
fable-planner; Opus reviews the plan & implements it.
Root Codex owns sign-off. Nontrivial work routes
through a Sol Ultra planner, then bounded delegation.

svg.text: ▼ delegate — independent chunks only
C
Worker fabric — bounded bulk work, cheap & parallel
HEAVY frontier models only — optimized for quality & diversity, not cost. Summarize, classify, draft, first-pass code/tests/review — anything you'd run 5–50× at once.

g.text: Ollama Cloud model — the worker atom.
The delegate pool the orchestrator fans out across.
No shared state → /fanout (workers report to root).

svg.text: ▲ results return — nothing is trusted yet
D
Governance spine — the gates that make it count
Worker output is a proposal until a deterministic check clears it. Selection is always a verifier — never the harness grading its own rewrite.

g.text: Tier 0 spec-gate before you even dispatch.
Tier 1 Opus-authored contract + mut mutation test.
Tier 2 boolean checklist + a different-family critic.
One governed fact per file under
Supersede, never append. Bitemporal + TTL decay.

svg.text: ▼ the harness improves itself
E
Self-improvement loop — continuous watch, event-driven act
↺ loop-until-dry, then back off
A SessionStart watcher captures flaws into a queue; a round fires only when it's actionable. An accepted round must resolve a real flaw or add an assertion — green ≠ progress.
▼ the same doctrine, pointed at the business
F
Hermes — the business orchestration plane
The dashboard the whole harness serves — one platform, exposed to the agents over MCP. A proactive layer perceives & queues; every round must move a real KPI.

text.tspan: — AUTO runs unattended · SELECT waits for human sign-off

svg.text: If you can't cheaply say what "correct" means, you don't delegate it — you do it in the frontier thread. Orchestrators are scarce
because judgment is scarce; workers are cheap and many because bounded work is cheap; the gates exist because an agent's
confidence is not evidence. The repo is the source of truth — the conversation is not — so state lives in queues and files.
orchestratormaxxing · a lab for frontier coding-agent orchestration
